Let me check if the level is completed when the square is all white and the indicator is under the white square.
Actually, the level is not completed after selecting the white tool and pressing SPACE. So the square being all white is not the goal.
Let me think about this differently. Maybe the goal is to have the square match the legend's left square exactly: white top, purple bottom.

- The square to have white on top and purple on bottom
- The indicator to be under the white square (white tool selected)
But when I select the white tool and press SPACE, the square becomes all white. When I select the purple tool and press SPACE, the square becomes purple-over-white.
Maybe I need to have the rectangle be a different shape. Let me try pressing LEFT (diamond) and then selecting the white tool and pressing SPACE.
